candidates.title: Towards Swift Serverless LLM Cold Starts with ParaServe
candidates.reason: Serverless cold-start system using pipeline parallelism to aggregate network bandwidth for model fetch, overlapping fetch/load/runtime initialization and consolidating pipelines after warmup; reports up to 4.7x cold-start reduction and 1.74x SLO attainment.

candidates.title: ServerlessLoRA: Minimizing Latency and Cost in Serverless Inference for LoRA-Based LLMs
candidates.reason: Serverless multi-LoRA system with shared backbone, artifact preloading, contention-aware batching and offloading; industrial workloads report up to 86% TTFT reduction and 89% cost reduction.

discovery_stats.axis: serverless model loading・cold start・LoRA artifact sharing
discovery_stats.query_summary: CPU-light KV offloadからmodel loading/cold-startへ切り替えた。ServerlessLLMは既知基礎系統として除外し、ParaServeとServerlessLoRAはdefault branchのcanonical ID/title検索で未収録を確認した。
